proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal – Accounting for Litigation and Compliance In Executive Compensation Performance Measures
proposals.proponent: The City of Philadelphia Public Employees Retirement System
proposals.topic_summary: Adopt policy that no financial performance metric for senior executive incentive pay be adjusted to exclude legal or compliance costs, including opioid litigation costs.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the adoption of this proposal for the following reasons:

proposals.title: Amendment to Shareholder Ability to Call Special Shareholder Meeting
proposals.topic_summary: Amend bylaws to give holders of 10% of outstanding common stock the power to call a special shareowner meeting, the most shareholder-friendly version permitted by state law.
proposals.evidence: It is, therefore, recommended that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal.
